senses.gloss: गृ r. 1st cl. (गरति) To sprinkle, to moisten or wet.

गॄ r. 6th cl. (गिरति or गिलति) To swallow, to eat. r. 9th cl. (गृणाति) To
sound, to sound intelligibly or articulately, to speak. r. 10th cl.
(गीरयते)
 1. To know.
 2. To make known, to teach. With निर् or उत्
prefixed, To reject, to vomit. With सम् and उत्, 1. To throw up.
 2.
To cry aloud.
